act: AIFC Banking Business Prudential Rules (BBR), V6

en.title: Operational risk policy rule copied from market risk: Governing Body must ensure a bank-wide view of 'Market Risk exposures'
en.summary: BBR 7.1(5) repeats 6.1(4) word for word except for the name of the policy: the operational risk management policy must give "a comprehensive bank-wide view of its Market Risk exposures" and take into account "the risk of a significant deterioration in market liquidity of its exposures". BBR 7.1(4)(d) likewise ties the review of the operational risk policy to the "nature, scale and complexity of its Trading Book activities" (copied from 6.1(3)(d)). The substance is partly covered elsewhere: 7.5(1)(a) requires the bank to identify operational risks in all its products, activities, processes and systems, and 7.5(1)(f) requires reporting to the Governing Body.
en.correction: Please read "Operational Risk exposures" for "Market Risk exposures" in 7.1(5) and "its business" for "its Trading Book activities" in 7.1(4)(d), and confirm whether the words on market liquidity in 7.1(5) are meant to stay.

quotes.source: AIFC Banking Prudential Rules_V6 (with amendments as of 13 April 2025, which commence on 13 October 2025)
quotes.text: A Bank’s Governing Body must ensure that its Operational risk management policy enables it to obtain a comprehensive bank-wide view of its Market Risk exposures

quotes.source: AIFC Banking Prudential Rules_V6 (with amendments as of 13 April 2025, which commence on 13 October 2025)
quotes.text: A Bank’s Governing Body must ensure that its Market Risk management policy enables it to obtain

quotes.text: ensure that it identifies and assesses the Operational Risks inherent in all the Bank’s products, activities, processes and systems;

quotes.text: ensure that appropriate reporting mechanisms are in place at its Governing Body, senior management, and business line levels to support effective management of the Bank’s Operational Risk;
